text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: sudden 8x spike in external action/toolcall latencies and errors across eu-west-1. Paging eng-sre rotation.

Alex (oncall): I'm on it. saw http 502s + timeout increases on action-exec pool. RTTs up ~300ms median.

Maya (SRE): confirming. spike started ~3215001050. 90th token generation latency for fn-invoke skyrocketed. error rate from external tool backend 15% -> 48%.

Jon (eng-runtime): rolling metrics show most of the load is from a handful of tenants doing heavy chain-of-tools. We should soft-fence toolcalls before aggressive plan-wide throttles.

Alex (oncall): propose two-step: 1) immediate soft-disable of non-critical external tool/function calls for Free and Starter plans (keep Premium untouched), 2) switch structured output generation off for affected nodes (stream plain text) to reduce pipeline overhead. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Maya (SRE): +1. runbook suggests "partial_action_gating" toggle. Can we do per-tenant gating so we don't blast all customers?

Jon (eng-runtime): yes. we have flags: `flags.action_exec.soft_fence=plan:starter,free` and `flags.output.structured_enabled=node_group:eu-west-1=false`. I'll queue the patch.

Alex (oncall): execute when ready. prefix with canary to 2 nodes, monitor error_rate & latency for 5m.

Emily (infra-bot): running command on 2 nodes: `curl -XPOST https://internal-api/flags -d '{"soft_fence":{"plans":["free","starter"]}}'` -> queued.

Jon (eng-runtime): canary applied to node-eu-1a. metrics: toolcall RPS down 60% on that node, median latency down 120ms. errors down to 18%. proceeding to 2 more nodes.

Priya (support): heads-up: customer-visible errors are happening for some smaller tenants. I'll draft comms for affected customers and coordinate with CS.

Liam (CS): pls attach sample tenant IDs, error windows, and remediation steps. we'll prepare a targeted email and update the status page part.

Alex (oncall): also enabling throttling at API gateway for action endpoints: `rate-limit: action_exec_per_tenant=0.5rps` for Starter/Free via config push. This will protect capacity while we restore stability.

Maya (SRE): observing spillover to streaming queues—will temporarily increase consumer parallelism on action-processor to avoid backlog. patch applied.

Jon (eng-runtime): additional optimization: disable KV cache prefetch for tool-response parsing on affected nodes: `runtime.flags.kv_prefetch=false` to reduce memory pressure. Applying now.

Emily (infra-bot): KV prefetch toggle applied to canary nodes.

Alex (oncall): monitoring 1m/5m windows. so far system latency trending down; error rate cluster-wide 48% -> 22% after partial gating and throttle. Good signal.

Priya (support): customer comms draft: "We're seeing higher failure rates for certain tool-driven workflows. We've temporarily restricted external tool/function calls for Free and Starter plans to restore stability. Premium customers unaffected. We're actively rolling fixes and will update in 30m." Should I send?

Liam (CS): send to affected list + post status page now. Include workaround: reduce concurrent toolchains, use text-only outputs for now.

Jon (eng-runtime): one more safeguard: enable automatic fallback to text-only responses in the service layer when structured output generation raises timeouts. Toggle: `fallback.text_only=true`. Doing it.

Maya (SRE): note: if load persists, next step per runbook is tenant quarantine for top offenders (temporary suspend action execution for specific tenant ids) + notify legal/contract teams for enterprise impacts.

Alex (oncall): please capture tenant IDs with highest action-exec QPS and error churn. Jon, Maya — can you produce a short list in the thread?

Jon (eng-runtime): pulling top offenders now: `tenant-1832`, `tenant-9921`, `tenant-4403` (high sustained chain calls). Will paste IDs in 2m.

Emily (infra-bot): canary expansion complete to eu-west-1 nodes. cluster metrics: 5m p50 latency -110ms, p95 -380ms -> -160ms.

Maya (SRE): prepping quarantine script: `quarantine_tenants.sh tenant-1832 tenant-9921 --duration=30m --notify=cs`. Holding until we confirm CS message.

Priya (support): go ahead on quarantine for tenant-1832 and tenant-9921. I'll send targeted messages and open support tickets.

Alex (oncall): execute quarantine.

Emily (infra-bot): quarantine executed for tenant-1832 & tenant-9921. action-exec requests rejected with 429 + clear error message.

Jon (eng-runtime): after quarantine, cluster error rate down to 9%, overall latency back to baseline-ish for p50. Remaining noise from tenant-4403 — will reach out to their CSM.

Liam (CS): pinging CSM for tenant-4403 now. we'll ask them to reduce parallelism or accept degraded toolcalls.

Priya (support): status page updated and targeted emails queued.

Maya (SRE): monitoring continues. recommend we keep soft-fence & structured-output disabled for free/starter for at least 30m and then re-evaluate.

Alex (oncall): agreed. I'll start a 1hr mitigation timer and handoff to night oncall in 45m. Please post any regressions here.

Jon (eng-runtime): doc note for postmortem: capture root cause (cascading chain-of-tool loops from a 3rd-party connector), failure modes, and mitigation effectiveness (soft-fence + per-tenant quarantine).

Priya (support): logging: attaching sample errors in the ticket: `action_exec: timeout 120s`, `agent: invalid-ack`, `structured: json-parse-timeout`.

Alex (oncall): great. thanks team. Handoff in 45m to @next-oncall. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
